Frederik Andersen is a professional ice hockey goaltender.  
In ice hockey, the blue line is part of the playing surface used for determining offside, but goaltenders rarely cross it during normal gameplay because they stay in or near their own defensive zone.  
However, in unusual situations (e.g., a delayed penalty, an extra attacker situation, or a goalie being pulled), a goalie could cross the blue line.  
The Stanley Cup is the championship trophy of the NHL, so the scenario is set in a high-stakes game where such an unusual event could plausibly occur.
